questions.question_text:
A student writes $\sqrt{81}\div\sqrt{9}\times 3=9\div 9=1$.
What is the correct value of $\sqrt{81}\div\sqrt{9}\times 3$?

options.why: Multiplied before dividing; division and multiplication are worked left to right.
Treated the division sign as a multiplication, working out $9\times 3\times 3$.
Worked out $\sqrt{81}\div\sqrt{9}=3$ and stopped, forgetting to multiply by $3$.

questions.solution_text:
Division and multiplication are worked left to right.
$\sqrt{81}\div\sqrt{9}\times 3$
$=9\div 3\times 3$
$=3\times 3$
$=9$
